title: Scoped Clinical Reapproval Packet: Four Text-Modified Cards

reviewer_statements.normalized_decision: Approve the clinical copy for all 4 cards, but schedule Card 3's image (oct17_do1.png) for replacement in the candidate generation phase.

governing_policy: Scoped clinical evaluation completed; clinical copy approved for 4 cards; Card 3 image scheduled for replacement candidate pipeline.

cards.day_title_gu: વિશ્વ હાથ ધોવાના દિવસ (ગ્લોબલ હેન્ડવોશિંગ ડે)
cards.desc_en: Rub palms, backs of hands, between fingers, fingertips and nails, thumbs, and wrists with soap for at least 20 seconds.
cards.desc_gu: હથેળી, હાથનો પાછળનો ભાગ, આંગળીઓની વચ્ચે, આંગળીના ટેરવા અને નખ, અંગૂઠા તથા કાંડા સાબુથી ઓછામાં ઓછા ૨૦ સેકન્ડ ઘસો.
cards.reason_for_reapproval: Clinical specification updated at Dr. Atul's request to explicitly name six handwashing areas (palms, backs, web spaces, fingertips/nails, thumbs, and wrists) for at least 20 seconds, and removed the unverified '80% of germs hide' claim.
cards.clinical_evidence_source: CDC Clean Hands Guidelines & WHO 6-Step Hand Hygiene Technique
cards.linguistic_concordance_notes: English and Gujarati terms align 1:1 across all six anatomical friction areas (હથેળી, હાથનો પાછળનો ભાગ, આંગળીઓની વચ્ચે, આંગળીના ટેરવા અને નખ, અંગૂઠા તથા કાંડા).
cards.medical_safety_notes: Meets clinical infection control standards. Clear, actionable, and non-prescriptive.
cards.polarity_assessment: Positive constructive instruction. Image depicts Indian hands with rich soap lather actively interlacing fingers and rubbing nails/thumbs.
cards.reviewer_notes: Clinical copy detailing 6 handwashing steps (palms, backs, web spaces, fingertips/nails, thumbs, and wrists) and soap lather image approved.

cards.title_gu: મોબાઈલ જોતી વખતે ગરદન વાંકી ન વાળો
cards.desc_en: Severe forward neck flexion significantly increases mechanical load on cervical vertebrae. Hold devices closer to eye level and change posture frequently.
cards.desc_gu: ડોક વધારે પડતી નીચી નમાવવાથી સર્વાઇકલ મણકા પર ભારે દબાણ આવે છે; ફોનને આંખની સામે રાખો અને વચ્ચે-વચ્ચે ગરદન હળવી કરો.
cards.reason_for_reapproval: Removed the unverified popular science claim that forward neck flexion exerts '27 kg' on cervical vertebrae (originating from a 2014 static mathematical model), replacing it with evidence-based biomechanical guidance to hold devices near eye level and change posture frequently.
cards.clinical_evidence_source: World Spine Day Guidelines & Hansraj KK (2014) Contextual Clinical Ergonomics
cards.linguistic_concordance_notes: English and Gujarati convey identical ergonomic instruction: severe neck flexion places heavy strain on cervical vertebrae; keep screen closer to eye level and relax neck periodically.
cards.medical_safety_notes: Avoids spurious static weight numbers; promotes dynamic posture variation and eye-level screen positioning.
cards.polarity_assessment: Positive corrective guidance. Image shows Indian youth sitting upright holding smartphone at eye level.
cards.reviewer_notes: Clinical copy for ergonomic mobile posture (holding phone near eye level, frequent posture relaxation) and upright sitting posture image approved.

cards.day_title_en: World Trauma Day (Road Safety & Golden Hour)
cards.day_title_gu: વિશ્વ ટ્રોમા દિવસ (માર્ગ સુરક્ષા અને ૧૦૮ ગોલ્ડન અવર)
cards.title_gu: ISI ચિહ્નિત ફુલ-ફેસ હેલ્મેટ અને સીટબેલ્ટ પહેરો
cards.desc_en: Fasten chin strap on two-wheelers; click three-point seatbelt in cars for front and rear passengers.
cards.desc_gu: બાઇક-સ્કૂટર પર ચિન-સ્ટ્રેપ સાથે ISI ચિહ્નિત હેલ્મેટ પહેરો; કારમાં આગળ-પાછળ બેસનાર દરેક વ્યક્તિ સીટબેલ્ટ અવશ્ય બાંધો.
cards.reason_for_reapproval: Added explicit 'ISI-marked' Bureau of Indian Standards specification to both English and Gujarati helmet wording at Dr. Atul's request, ensuring non-certified novelty headgear is strictly excluded.
cards.clinical_evidence_source: Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019 / Bureau of Indian Standards (IS 4151) / WHO Road Safety Manual
cards.linguistic_concordance_notes: English 'ISI-Marked Full-Face Helmet & Seatbelt' matches Gujarati 'ISI ચિહ્નિત ફુલ-ફેસ હેલ્મેટ અને સીટબેલ્ટ પહેરો' with exact chin-strap and 3-point seatbelt guidance.
cards.medical_safety_notes: High clinical impact for craniofacial and traumatic brain injury prevention in Indian traffic conditions.
cards.polarity_assessment: Safety equipment instruction. Visual photo rejected due to dual steering wheels AI hallucination ('Two person driving the car'); scheduled for replacement candidate generation.
cards.defect_description: AI-generated dual steering wheels / two people appearing to drive simultaneously in the front vehicle seats
cards.reviewer_notes: Clinical copy with ISI-marked helmet and seatbelt guidance approved. Visual photo rejected due to dual steering wheels AI hallucination; scheduled for controlled replacement candidate generation.

cards.desc_en: Excess tea, coffee, and sugary Indian sweets trigger severe hot flashes and accelerate bone calcium loss.
cards.desc_gu: વધુ પડતી ચા-કૉફી અને ખાંડવાળી ભારતીય મીઠાઈઓથી તીવ્ર હોટ ફ્લશ થઈ શકે છે અને હાડકાંમાં કેલ્શિયમનું નુકસાન ઝડપથી વધી શકે છે.
cards.reason_for_reapproval: Corrected Gujarati translation error for 'Excess tea, coffee, and sugary Indian sweets', ensuring accurate rendering of vasomotor hot-flash triggers and bone calcium metabolism warnings.
cards.clinical_evidence_source: International Menopause Society (IMS) White Paper on Menopausal Health
cards.linguistic_concordance_notes: English and Gujarati accurately describe the risk: excessive tea, coffee and sugary sweets can trigger severe hot flashes and accelerate bone calcium loss.
cards.medical_safety_notes: Sound lifestyle and dietary counseling for perimenopausal and menopausal symptom moderation.
cards.polarity_assessment: Professional medical counsel. Image shows supportive consultation between an Indian woman and an experienced female gynecologist.
cards.reviewer_notes: Clinical copy advising qualified gynecologist consultation and corrected Gujarati translation regarding moderation of excess tea, coffee, and sweets approved.
